3. compute_exchange_rate USD->EUR
4. Compare flight cost to balance.

Then get_credit_card_balance with access_token="abc123xyz", card_id="card_7243".

Then compare flight_cost <= balance. If yes, respond accordingly. If not, respond accordingly.
